result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.delete_edges_ws()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Delete all selected edges. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L1013-L1085){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.delete_edges_ws() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Removes edges in the current selection from the graph. Node connectivity may be affected, but nodes themselves remain in the graph. Updates selection state automatically. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Delete specific edges from a path: ::: {#05476484 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph().add_path_graph(5) # Creates path: 0-1-2-3-4 # Select and delete middle edges edge_ids = graph.get_edge_ids()[1:3] # Get edges 1 and 2 graph.select_edges_by_id(edge_ids) graph.delete_edges_ws() # All nodes remain graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 5 ``` ::: ::: Check remaining edges: ::: {#247fad04 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph().add_path_graph(5) edge_ids = graph.get_edge_ids()[1:3] graph.select_edges_by_id(edge_ids) graph.delete_edges_ws() # Only first and last edges remain graph.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 2 ``` ::: ::: Delete edges by filtering: ::: {#299ccba4 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge(source="A", target="B", weight=1.0) .add_edge(source="B", target="C", weight=5.0) .add_edge(source="C", target="D", weight=2.0) ) # Delete low-weight edges graph.select_edges(lambda e: e.weight and e.weight < 2.0) graph.delete_edges_ws() # Edges with weight >= 2.0 remain graph.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
